## Receptive field

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}

![](images/rf.png){width="100%"}

:::

::: {.column width="20%"}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\lambda(t)
&= \lambda_0 \\
&\quad +
\underbrace{
\iiint dxdyd\tau\,
\mathcal{K}(x,y,\tau)\,
\mathcal{S}(x,y,t-\tau)
}_{\mathcal{L}}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
